test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All oceans are rivers.

Some rivers are ponds.

Conclusions:

(I) All ponds are oceans.

(II) Some oceans are ponds.
solution:
Statements:

All oceans are rivers.

Some rivers are ponds.

 

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82d778a5199d3e148db73ac948c45548acc8f67e49d8968750f5c0aa93a5a7ef.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35eca042ddea281452af573fc2d07bdafdd0a767fa221754b5cd13359c39526e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All ponds are oceans - False (because there is no direct relation between ponds and oceans so it can be possible but not definite)

(II) Some oceans are ponds. - False (because there is no direct relation between ponds and oceans so it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows".
